services.name: Admission
services.desc: Looking for a perfect souvenir or gift, but don’t want to carry it home? Look through our extensive online Museum store and ship it! The mission of America’s Packard Museum is to educate both current and future generations about the Packard Motor Car Company, its products, and its philosophies. services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: America’s Packard Museum is a perennial destination for groups all kinds of regional and national automobile car clubs, as well as motorcycle, aircraft, and boat clubs. We love all types of vehicles, so bring your club to the most unique venue in Dayton, Ohio. Regardless of brand, clubs often join us for guided group tours, event lunches, banquet dinners, or monthly meetings. The Museum is a great backdrop for the conversation around automotive collection and preservation. Clubs representing any make or model are welcome!
